text.p: Thermo Sentron Inc said Wednesday it acquired Westerland Engineering Ltd for about $1.9 million in cash, subject to a post-closing adjustment.

Nottingham, England-based Westerland had revenues of about $3.2 million in 1996. It is a manufacturer of process weighing and control equipment, and its products are used to feed the correct proportions of ingredients such as powders, liquids and granules during continuous production processes.
The company said the acquisition gives it an entrance to the $200 million global market for small-capacity feeders.
Thermo Sentron provides high-speed precision-weighing and inspection equipment.
